# Where does AI fit?

## My guess

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="40%"}
- Agents build and check
- The mechanism stays the object
- People keep the question, the judgement of fitness for use, and the
  trust of the people who act on the numbers
- The lines I have drawn between the columns have moved since I drew
  them
:::
::: {.column width="60%"}
![](../figures/keynote-who.png){width="100%"
fig-alt="Three boxes side by side. Agents, build and check: data
ingest, pipelines, tests, docs, releases, reading French PDFs. The
mechanism, stays the object: infections, delays, Rt, ascertainment, the
thing being estimated. People, keep: the question, fitness for use, the
trust of those who act on the numbers."}

::: {.attribution}
A guess. The moving line is from [how I LLM](https://samabbott.co.uk/how-I-llm),

months · diagram this talk, `scripts/keynote-schematics.py`
:::
